title: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
shortDescription: An open-world adventure that makes weather, tools, terrain, and curiosity into flexible ways of approaching nearly every problem.
highlights: Movement systems turn the landscape into an invitation rather than a checklist
Physics-driven solutions make experiments feel genuinely player-owned
keywords: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild

signals.label: GameAtlas editorial selection
signals.rationale: A core Switch adventure pick for its unusually generous approach to exploration and problem solving.
